title: Bending the Spoon
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Tomoki Hoshiko, a high-school student others avoid as a delinquent, and Hidaka Asai, the friendless top student, are accidentally teleported away from school together. Hidaka then confesses he has psychic powers, and his mind reading seems to let him see the Tomoki no one else does (Renta! blurb via AniList and MangaUpdates). A one-volume boys' love romance on Renta!.
life_message: Being truly seen by one person can undo a lonely reputation.
